main.description: Marks that this account has opted into hashteams' (hashteams.bisks.net) public roster. Carries no team number — a reader always recomputes the team from the record's own repo DID (UTF-8 encode -> SHA-256 -> first two bytes, big-endian -> 0-65535), so the roster can never disagree with the algorithm. The site reads the network for every repo holding this collection (com.atproto.sync.listReposByCollection + Jetstream) to build a public list of who's on each team; an account only appears if it wrote this record itself. Written and read by hashteams (https://hashteams.bisks.net).

createdAt.description: When this account joined the roster, as an ISO 8601 datetime.
